title: MIAT as a Harness for LLM Coding Agents: Replication Package
description: Replication package for the manuscript "Model-Driven Harnesses for LLM Coding Agents: Contract-Bounded Generation under Synthesized Controllers" (submitted to IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering). It contains the harness artifacts (requirements, action contracts, test vectors, GRAFCET models), the rule-based controller synthesizer, the Gate M model checker, the AGV-DockSim surrogate simulator, 48 agent-generated programs with their CR-1 revisions, sanitized transcripts of all 51 agent runs, raw trial logs, and scripts that regenerate every table and figure. Code is released under the MIT License (LICENSE); data, generated programs, transcripts and documents under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA).
